title: Pia Cayetano, Padilla cast doubt on forensic analyst in Duterte trial
summary: Senator-judges Pia Cayetano and Robin Padilla raised questions about the credibility of the forensic analyst — and his findings — who testified in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.
